description: This file defines CLI commands for managing browser cookies and storage (localStorage/sessionStorage) via a command-line interface, including functions to resolve URLs and target IDs, and to perform get/set/clear operations.

methods.name: resolveUrl
methods.description: Resolves the URL from options or inherited options.

methods.name: resolveTargetId
methods.description: Resolves the target ID from raw input or inherited options.

methods.name: runMutationRequest
methods.description: Performs a browser request mutation with error handling and optional JSON output.

methods.name: registerBrowserCookiesAndStorageCommands
methods.description: Registers CLI commands for cookies and storage management in the browser CLI.
